title: Signed expiring tokens for confirmation links
interface:
final class HandoverTokens. Constructor: __construct(\Drupal\Core\PrivateKey $privateKey, \Drupal\Component\Datetime\TimeInterface $time). Service 'hwdesk.handover_tokens' (already registered with ['@private_key', '@datetime.time']).
issue(int $handoverId, int $uid, int $expires): string -- token = <payload>.<signature>; payload = base64url (Drupal\Component\Utility\Crypt::hmacBase64 style alphabet: RFC 4648 URL-safe, no padding) of the string "$handoverId:$uid:$expires"; signature = Crypt::hmacBase64(payload, $privateKey->get()). The whole token matches /^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$/.
verify(string $token): ?array -- ['handover' => int, 'uid' => int, 'expires' => int] when the token has exactly one '.', the signature equals Crypt::hmacBase64(payload, key) (compare with hash_equals), the payload decodes to three non-negative integers, and expires >= $time->getRequestTime(); NULL otherwise (never throw).
Use Drupal\Component\Utility\Crypt for hmacBase64 and for base64url (Crypt::hmacBase64 output alphabet; for the payload use rtrim(strtr(base64_encode(...), '+/', '-_'), '=') and the reverse). File header: <?php + declare(strict_types=1); namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Service; final class; constructor property promotion with readonly; no \Drupal:: static calls (everything is injected); no other new files.
